tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one public CMS article section or the next bounded content chunk.

id.description: Stable article ID returned by list_articles.

section.description: Optional section key returned by an article read.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned when more section text remains.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one approved Pages-owned public page section or bounded continuation.

section.description: Optional section key returned by a page read.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned when more section text remains.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List bounded metadata for public articles published on this site.

query.description: Optional title or excerpt search text.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous list call.
